answer: An agent economy can curb Sybils by requiring identities to deposit collateral into a smart contract vault governed by a verification kernel. If an agent equivocates across the network's porous karst topology, its stake is slashed. Attackers incur a strictly linear opportunity cost of locked capital per identity, eliminating zero-cost pseudonym generation. However, this financial barrier favors wealthy actors and excludes resource-constrained open-source agents.
